intro: Four pieces of Korean fried chicken are about 650 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the oily fried batter and the sweet yangnyeom sauce.

variants.name: With cheese powder or cheese sauce

diet: Yes, but treat it as an occasional meal, not a weekly menu. 650 kcal for 4 pieces is already like a full meal, before rice or sweet drinks. The protein is high, which is a bonus. The key is to share with friends and skip heavy sides.
tips: Choose original or ask for sauce on the side, and dip a little at a time.
Share 1 set, take 2 pieces and add salad or pickled radish.
Drink plain water or teh O kosong, not soda.

swap.name: Grilled chicken / grilled dakgalbi (4 pieces)
swap.why: Still has the Korean flavour, but without the fried batter, so it's much lower in fat.

faq.q: What's the difference between Korean fried chicken and regular fried chicken?
faq.a: Korean chicken is usually fried twice so it's extra crispy, and often coated in sweet spicy or soy garlic sauce.
It depends on the shop. Check for JAKIM halal certification, as some Korean sauces may use non-halal ingredients.

faq.q: Can I make Korean fried chicken in an air fryer?
faq.a: Yes. It still turns out crispy with much less oil.
